fragments.text: Good morning. Stretton Festival box office. How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 早上好，这里是斯特顿节日售票处，请问有什么能帮您？

fragments.text: Oh, hello. My family and I are on holiday in the area, and we've seen some posters about the
this week. Could you tell me about some of the
please?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 哦，您好，我和家人在这边度假，我们看到了一些这周的节日海报。能告诉我最近有什么活动吗？

fragments.text: Of course.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 没问题。

fragments.text: First of all, are there still
available for the
on Saturday?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我想先问一下现在还有周六爵士乐队的票吗？

fragments.text: There are, but only
. The
have all been sold.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 有，但是只有15英镑的票了。12英镑的票售罄了。

fragments.text: OK. And the venue is the
school, isn't it?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的。场地是在这个学校，对吗？

fragments.text: Yes, that's right, the
. Make sure you don't go to the primary school by

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 是的，是在这个中学部里。可别走到小学部那里哦！

fragments.text: And there's an
who isn't mentioned on the posters - Carolyn Hart is going to play with the

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 表演里还有一场额外演出——海报中并未提及——那就是卡洛琳•哈特将和乐队一起表演。

fragments.text: Oh, I think I've heard her on the radio. Doesn't she play the oboe, or flute or something?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 哦，我好像从广播里听说了。她不是演奏双簧管或是长笛什么的吗？

fragments.text: Yes, the
. She usually plays with
and apparently this is her first time with a

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 对，她是演奏长笛的。她经常和管弦乐队表演。这是她第一次和爵士乐队一起表演。

fragments.text: Well, I'd certainly like to hear her.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 嗯，我很期待她的演出。

fragments.text: Then the next thing I want to ask about is the duck races - I saw a poster beside a river. What are they, exactly?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 接下来我想咨询一下那个鸭子比赛。我在河边的海报看到的，具体是什么呢？

fragments.text: Well, you buy a yellow
- or as many as you like - they're a pound each. And you write your name on each one. There'll be
depending on the number of ducks taking part. And John Stevens, a champion swimmer who lives locally, is going to start the races. All the ducks will be
into the river at the back of the cinema, then they'll float along the river for as far as the railway bridge.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 嗯，您到时候可以买一只或是几只黄色的塑料鸭子，每只鸭子1英镑。然后您可以在上面写上您的名字。我们会根据参与的鸭子的数量安排比赛场次。约翰•史蒂文斯就住在这边，他会负责启动比赛。所有鸭子会被放置到电影院后面的河边，然后他们会沿河漂流500米，直到铁路大桥。

fragments.text: And are there

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那么有奖品吗？

fragments.text: Yes, the first duck in each race to arrive at the finishing line wins its owner
for the concert on the last night of the festival.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 有，每次比赛获得第一名的将得到假期最后一天晚上音乐会的门票。

fragments.text: You said you can buy a duck? I'm sure my children will both want one. They're on sale at a stall in the market. You can't miss it - it's got an
showing a couple of ducks.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 您是说您这里可以买鸭子吗？我想我的孩子们肯定很想要一只。市场的货架上就有卖的。您肯定会找到的，就是一群标着大大的标签的鸭子。

fragments.text: OK. I'll go there this afternoon. I remember walking past there yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好的，我下午去看看。我记得我昨天路过那里。

fragments.text: Now could you tell me something about the flower show, please?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 能再跟我说一下花展的活动吗？

fragments.text: Well,
and the show is being held in Bythwaite Hall.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 嗯，门票免费，地点在百思味特大厅。

fragments.text: Sorry, how do you spell that?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 抱歉，能告诉我怎么拼吗？

fragments.text: Bythwaite.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: B-Y-T-H-W-A-I-T-E，百思味特。

fragments.text: Is it easy to find? I'm not very
the town yet.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那里好找吗？我对这个城镇还不是很熟悉。

fragments.text: Oh, you won't have any problem. It's right in the centre of Stretton. It's the only
in the town, so it's easy to recognise.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 哦，没有问题的，它就在斯特顿的中心。这个镇上唯一的一个老建筑，很容易识别的。

fragments.text: I know it. I presume it's open all day.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我知道那个建筑。我觉得它全天都开放。

fragments.text: Yes, but if you'd like to see the prizes being awarded for the
you'll need to
there at

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 是的，但是如果您想看最美花朵的颁奖仪式，您需要5点前到那里。

fragments.text: The prizes are being given by a
Kevin Shapless. He lives nearby and gets involved in a lot of
events.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 奖金由著名演员凯文•沙普勒斯提供。他住在附近并且参与了好多社区活动。

fragments.text: Gosh, I've seen him on TV. I'll definitely go to the

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 天呐，我在电视上见过他。我一定要去看看颁奖仪式。

fragments.text: Right.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 好吧。

fragments.text: I've seen a list of plays that are being performed this week, and I'd like to know which are
my children, and which ones my husband and I might go to.

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我看了一下这周的表演名单，我想问一下哪些适合我的孩子们，哪些适合我和我的先生？

fragments.text: How old are your children?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 您家孩子多大了？

fragments.text: Five and seven. What about 'The Mystery of Muldoon'?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 一个5岁一个7岁。神秘的马尔登怎么样？

fragments.text: That's aimed at
. So if I take my children, I can expect them to enjoy it more than I do?

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 那个适合5-10岁的儿童。那如果我带他们去，我想他们会比我收获更多对吗？

fragments.text: I think so. If you'd like something for yourself and your husband, and leave your children with a babysitter, you might like to see 'Fire and Flood' - it's about
that really happened in Stretton two hundred years ago, and children might find it rather

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 我认为是这样的。如果您把孩子托给保姆，您和您先生可以看看“火与血”——那是关于发生在两百年前的斯特顿的事，小孩子看可能会害怕。

fragments.text: Oh, thanks for the

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 哦，谢谢提醒。

fragments.text: And finally, what about 'Silly Sailor'?

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 那么最后我想问问“愚蠢的水手”。

fragments.text: That's a
, and it's for young and old. In fact, it won an award in the Stretton Drama Festival
ago.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 那是个喜剧，老少皆宜。几个月前，它还在斯特顿戏剧节上获奖了。

fragments.text: OK. Well, goodbye, and thanks for all the information. I'm looking forward to the festival!

sentences.speaker: Woman
sentences.translation: 好吧，那么我就告辞了，感谢您的信息。我很期待这次的假期！

fragments.text: Goodbye.

sentences.speaker: Staff
sentences.translation: 再见。
